recipe.criteria: Lie on side with bent knees, feet together, and resistance band above knees. Keep pelvis and back still while lifting top knee against band; slowly close without rolling backward. 3.5 seconds open, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds close.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative; lower only while keeping the back supported.
